description: This source file defines a class `LLMClientCache` that extends an in-memory cache to add event loop awareness to cache keys, specifically to prevent errors related to closed event loops in asynchronous contexts. It provides methods for setting and retrieving cache entries, both synchronously and asynchronously, incorporating the current asyncio event loop ID into cache keys.

classes.name: LLMClientCache
classes.description: A cache class extending `InMemoryCache` that appends the current asyncio event loop ID to cache keys to prevent 'event loop closed' errors.

methods.name: update_cache_key_with_event_loop(self, key)
methods.description: Enhances the cache key by appending the current asyncio event loop's ID to prevent errors related to closed event loops.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Sets a cache entry after augmenting the key with the current event loop ID.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache entry after augmenting the key with the current event loop ID.

methods.name: get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry after augmenting the key with the current event loop ID.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache entry after augmenting the key with the current event loop ID.
